definition: The shape of one systematic-uncertainty envelope over the per-class balancing yield. This file is the CONTRACT, not an envelope. tools/systematics_envelope.py writes envelope INSTANCES into the commit-scoped results plane and validates them against this file; ./hadronization plot --systematics PATH revalidates an instance before it renders anything.
authority: Ruling R7 in the internal DECISIONS.md approves one tracked envelope artifact, written only by ./hadronization systematics and consumed only through an explicit plot --systematics flag. The statistics are PRACTICE section 5 and the 2026-08-18 owner amendment.
detachable: Systematics are OFF by default. Every accepted output was produced without an envelope, and no nominal render reads this contract or any envelope instance.

status_values.COMPLETE: Every included source produced a PASS measurement receipt, every receipt agreed with its declared resolver tag, every input carried the v2 class partition, and every row combined. Only a COMPLETE envelope may be rendered.
status_values.INCOMPLETE: At least one included source is unavailable. The reason is in `missing`. The envelope carries whatever it could derive and MUST NOT be rendered.
status_values.FAIL: A declared input contradicted itself: a receipt reported FAIL, a receipt disagreed with its resolver tag, or a class partition disagreed with the v2 contract. The reason is in `missing`. The producing tool exits nonzero.

row_identity.campaign: The NOMINAL campaign the envelope applies to, for example HF_RUN3_V1. The variation campaigns appear per source term, not in the row identity.
row_identity.tune: One of MONASH, JUNCTIONS, CLOSEPACKING. The three tunes are the measurement; the envelope is computed for each separately and is never taken across them.
row_identity.trigger_and_associate: The heavy-flavour pair, for example trigger B^{+} with associate Lambda_b. `flavour` is BEAUTY or CHARM.
row_identity.observable: balancing_yield -- the per-trigger balancing yield Y_bal = (N_OS - N_SS)/N_trig.
row_identity.class: One of c1..c11 from config/multiplicity_percentile_classes_v2.json, or MB for the multiplicity-integrated bin.

term_fields.campaign: The variation campaign whose arm was quoted for this source in this row.
term_fields.delta: Delta = variation - nominal, absolute, in the yield's own units. PRACTICE section 5 rule 5.
term_fields.sem_var: The standard error of the variation mean over its ten file blocks, dof 9.
term_fields.sem_nominal: The standard error of the nominal mean over its ten file blocks, dof 9.
term_fields.sem_delta: SEM(Delta) = sqrt(sem_var^2 + sem_nominal^2). Amendment D2. The two generations are independent, so the errors add in quadrature.
term_fields.contribution: max(|delta|, sem_delta). Amendment A1, applied continuously with no threshold cliff.
term_fields.delta_percent: delta as a percentage of the row's nominal yield.
term_fields.contribution_percent: contribution as a percentage of the row's nominal yield. The quadrature runs in per cent; the nominal is a common positive factor, so max() and quadrature commute with the rescaling.

row_fields.nominal_yield: The sealed nominal balancing yield for this row.
row_fields.nominal_sem: Its standard error over the ten blocks.
row_fields.terms: One entry per included source that contributed, keyed by source name.
row_fields.quoted_arm: Source name to the campaign whose arm was quoted, per pre-registration 2.5.
row_fields.dropped: Source names removed by pre-registration 9.1, where mu_F and the PDF act on the same object and only the larger is quoted.
row_fields.combined_percent: The quadrature sum of every contribution_percent, per cent.

method_tags.d2_quadrature: SEM(Delta) = sqrt(SEM_var^2 + SEM_nominal^2). Amendment D2, PRACTICE section 5 rule 6.
method_tags.a1_max_rule: Each source contributes max(|Delta|, SEM(Delta)) per class, applied continuously. Amendment A1, PRACTICE section 5 rule 7.
method_tags.a2_s6_excluded: S6 stays out of the per-class quadrature. It lives on the M1..M5 partition and nothing is summed across incompatible partitions. Amendment A2, PRACTICE section 5 rule 8.

provenance_fields.producing_commit: The forty-character commit of the checkout that wrote the envelope.
provenance_fields.envelope_contract_sha256: sha256 of this file as read.
provenance_fields.delta_report_sha256: sha256 of the per-class delta report the envelope was built from.
provenance_fields.measurement_receipts: Campaign to {receipt_sha256, completion_status, expected_complete_root_tag, resolved_complete_root_tags}. One entry per included variation campaign.
provenance_fields.resolver_tags: Campaign to the complete-root tag the dataset selector declares. A receipt whose resolved tag differs is a FAIL, never a warning.
provenance_fields.nominal_boundary_receipt_sha256: sha256 of the multiplicity_boundary_receipt_v2.json written by the NOMINAL render this envelope applies to. plot --systematics refuses unless this equals the sha of the receipt in the nominal plotting plane.
provenance_fields.nominal_dataset: The dataset key of the nominal render, for example hf_run3_v1_candidate.

refusals: An included source without a PASS measurement receipt.
A receipt whose resolved_complete_root_tags disagree with the selector's complete_root_tag.
An input row whose class is not in the v2 percentile contract.
A per-class delta report whose class set does not cover the v2 partition.
Any attempt to write an envelope under a plotting output plane.
not_a_systematic: The spread between tune bundles is the measurement. It never enters an envelope.
